posts.text:
Bill Raftery and Grant Hill reacting to the UConn winner is sublime. Enjoy:

Video
Those Boozer brother commercials that air every commercial break are about to become some of the most meme’d in sports history.

One of the most incredible endings in NCAA tourney history. Duke is up two with the ball and ten seconds left on the inbounds. Pure madness.

Video
Just hold the ball and get fouled! They didn’t even have to get it across half court.
UConn! Unbelievable.

Vols have lost in Elite 8 the past three seasons to one seeds that are just better than they are. In this day and age of perpetual free agency every season is a brand new roster, essentially. Not sure how many years Barnes has left, think it’s now or later for top roster.

Michigan is really good and destroyed Tennessee today. Three straight Elite 8’s is a great run for Vols. Big UT boosters & administration have a decision to make — how much money are they willing to give Rick Barnes to give him a truly elite roster?
It’s final four or bust yet again for the Tennessee Vols. Let’s get some good karma going by naming a random Tennessee Vol basketball player from your childhood. I’ll start. Doug. Roth!

Big for Vandy. He’s going to win a ton of games with Commodores.


On3 (@On3)

NEW: Vanderbilt head basketball coach Mark Byington has signed a long-term extension, @JoeTipton confirms⚓️

on3.com/news/mark-byington-v…

Big get for Tennessee. Part of the elite crop of Nashville area high school players that have exploded in state over the past decade or so.


Hayes Fawcett (@Hayesfawcett3)

BREAKING: Elite 2027 WR Kesean Bowman has Committed to Tennessee, he tells me for @Rivals  The 6’1 175 WR from Nashville, TN chose the Vols over Ohio State, Alabama, and Vanderbilt 

“Roots too deep to leave… I’m home🍊”  on3.com/rivals/kesean-bowman…
